title: Opening Keynote: The Future of Developer Communities
description: Kick off DevFest 2026 with a look at how developer communities are evolving, and how you can get involved.

title: Building AI-Powered Applications
description: An introduction to building modern applications with artificial intelligence: prompting, tool use, evaluation and shipping to production.

title: Modern Web Performance
description: Practical techniques for improving Core Web Vitals: from image delivery to JavaScript budgets and render-blocking resources.

title: One Team, Two Platforms: Flutter & Kotlin
description: How to decide between Flutter and native Kotlin, and how to share code and design across platforms.

title: Serverless on the Cloud
description: Design patterns for event-driven, scalable serverless apps and the pitfalls to avoid when going to production.

title: Agents in Production
description: What breaks when LLM agents meet real users, and how to add guardrails, tracing and evaluations.

title: Workshop: Build a RAG Chatbot
description: A hands-on workshop: build a retrieval-augmented chatbot from scratch. Bring a laptop.

title: Kubernetes Without Tears
description: A pragmatic tour of Kubernetes for application developers: what to learn, what to skip and what to automate.

title: Accessible by Default
description: Make accessibility part of your design system and CI pipeline so it stops being an afterthought.

title: Keynote: Sustaining Open Source
description: Why open source projects burn out and what communities and companies can do about it.

title: Designing for On-Device AI
description: Latency, privacy and battery: building mobile experiences powered by on-device machine learning.

title: Panel: Careers in Tech
description: Three engineers share how they built their careers, switched specialties and kept learning.

title: Workshop: Deploy Full-Stack Apps to Cloud Run
description: Containerize and deploy a React + Node application to a serverless container platform.

title: Closing & Lightning Talks
description: Fast five-minute talks from the community followed by closing remarks.
